cues: Bt cotton was approved in India in two thousand and two and now covers about ninety percent of the cotton area there.
Bt brinjal was approved in Bangladesh in two thousand and thirteen, the first genetically engineered food crop in South Asia.
Other crops carry a virus coat protein gene against that virus, or an R N A interference construct that silences a nematode's own gene.
